scope: Scoped functional engine changes with unchanged printed specs. Evidence records, not executable canonical fields. General-rule applicability and live-rollout uncertainty remain explicit.

events.description: Immune heroes can play health-cost cards even when that cost is above current health. Applies to Violet Illusionist immunity through the general rule.
events.confidence: high general rule; exact card application inferred from its original immunity text
events.limits: No first-match raw game log or replay was inspected.

events.description: Ethereal Peddler cost reduction no longer persists through cards replaced by Lilian Voss or Golden Kobold.
events.limits: No first-match raw game log or replay was inspected.

events.description: Deck-to-battlefield copied minions retain enchantments. Applies to Barnes copies under the general copying-rules update.
events.confidence: high general rule; Barnes-specific effect corroborated by card history, no engine script inspected
events.limits: No first-match raw game log or replay was inspected.

events.description: With Crystal Core active, Barnes now summons its specified 1/1 copy rather than a 4/4. Official patch explicitly uses Barnes as the example.
events.limits: No first-match raw game log or replay was inspected.

events.description: Onyx Bishop resurrects the minion to its own right, instead of at the far right end of the board.
events.limits: No first-match raw game log or replay was inspected.

events.description: Health or Armor costs no longer count as damage; immunity does not prevent payment. Applies to Violet Illusionist through the general immunity rule.
events.confidence: high general rule; exact card application inferred from its original immunity text
events.limits: No first-match raw game log or replay was inspected.

events.description: Fixed occasional re-summoning of the targeted minion on the wrong side of the board.
